title: The Whole Orchard
author: Zephyrine Vasquez
blurb: Quentin Crane, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, has spent twelve years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
